title: EFC Background No-Go Theorem: Why Background-Level Modification Cannot Suppress Structure Growth
description: Research note establishing a no-go result for observable background-level modifications in Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) under joint Planck 2018 CMB distance priors and DESI DR1 BAO constraints. Three independent parameterisations (linear α·T(a), exponential Geff = G0 exp(aG S), and a regime-aware piecewise H(z)) all show that BAO-improving low‑z changes to H(z) necessarily shift the CMB angular diameter distance DA(z∗) and are ruled out. The result closes Level 3 (background H(z)) at current precision and redirects EFC phenomenology to the perturbation sector (µ, Σ).

distance_measures.description: Comoving, radial, and angular diameter distances as functionals of the expansion history H(z); DA(z*) is the key CMB distance prior.

linear_coupling.description: Test 1 parameterisation: a linear background coupling that perturbs the Friedmann equation via a bounded gate T(a).

exponential_coupling.description: Test 2 parameterisation: an exponential effective-gravity coupling localised to low redshift by the entropy sigmoid S(a) with parameters (a_t, \sigma).

piecewise_regime_model.latex: H(z) = \begin{cases} H_{\Lambda \mathrm{CDM}}(z), & z \ge z_{\mathrm{switch}} \\ H_{\mathrm{EFC}}(z), & z < z_{\mathrm{switch}} \end{cases}
piecewise_regime_model.description: Test 3 parameterisation: regime-aware piecewise expansion history with a low-z modified regime and high-z \LambdaCDM regime.

da_integral_split.description: DA(z*) integrates through the low‑z modified regime; even percent-level changes in H(z) at z < 1 shift the CMB distance prior.

key_results.main_finding: Any low-z background modification to H(z) large enough to improve BAO is decisively excluded by CMB distance priors; the EFC background is effectively ΛCDM at current precision and observable effects must reside in the perturbation sector.
parameters_tested: α in H^2 = H_ΛCDM^2 (1 + α T(a))
a_G in Geff = G0 exp(a_G S(a))
(a_t, σ) of the entropy sigmoid S(a)
datasets_used: DESI DR1 BAO (DM/rd, DH/rd; 14 points, z ≈ 0.3–2.3)
Planck 2018 CMB distance priors (ℓ_a, R; z* = 1089.92)

sealed_predictions.statement: With improved precision (e.g., Euclid, DESI DR3), joint BAO+CMB distance-prior analyses will continue to find |δH/H| < 0.5% at 0 < z < 1 consistent with CMB DA(z*) constraints; any >1% background deviation jointly preferred would contradict the no-go.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Reconstruction of H(z) at 0 < z < 1 with ≲0.2% errors showing a >1% deviation from ΛCDM that remains consistent with CMB distance priors (|Δχ2_CMB| ≲ 5).

sealed_predictions.statement: If BAO residuals persist, they will be attributable to perturbation-sector effects (e.g., µ(k, z) ≠ 1) rather than background H(z) changes.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Full-shape BAO+RSD+lensing analyses demonstrating that µ(k, z) ≈ 1 is required while a low‑z background modification alone resolves the BAO residual without violating CMB DA(z*).

kill_criteria: KC1: A joint BAO+CMB distance-prior analysis that finds a consistent low-z background deviation δH/H ≳ 1.5% at z ≈ 0.5 with |Δχ2_CMB| ≤ 5 while improving BAO by Δχ2 ≤ −5.

KC2: Independent direct H(z) probes (cosmic chronometers, standard sirens, strong-lens time delays) detect >1% departures from ΛCDM over 0.3 < z < 1 that remain compatible with CMB DA(z*) constraints.

KC3: Full-shape BAO+RSD+weak lensing forward-modelling shows perturbation-only EFC (µ, Σ modifications) cannot account for BAO residuals without degrading lensing or growth fits, while a background H(z) modification alone provides a consistent global improvement.

related_packages.role: Provides the entropy sigmoid S(a) and exponential Geff parameterisation used in Test 2.
Planck MCMC constraints on linear α·T(a) coupling used in Test 1.

beta.description: Background coupling amplitude from four-channel test

analytical.name: Sign Lemma
analytical.statement: ΔE²(z) = A·[g(z) − g(0)] ≤ 0 for all z > 0
analytical.proof: Under closure normalisation E(0) = 1, the gate g(z) is monotonically decreasing for z > 0 (activates at late times). Therefore g(z) ≤ g(0) for all z > 0, and with A > 0, ΔE² ≤ 0.
analytical.corollary: H_EFC(z) ≤ H_ΛCDM(z) → reduced Hubble friction → enhanced structure growth
analytical.implication: Background-level EFC structurally excluded for σ₈ suppression

numerical.name: CLASS v3.3.4 Verification
numerical.conclusion: Growth is enhanced at all redshifts — opposite direction from S₈ tension amelioration

alpha_H0_degeneracy.interpretation: CMB is blind to α; BAO breaks the degeneracy

four_channel_test.note: Background coupling consistent but not sufficient for σ₈ suppression

architectural_consequence.reason: Sign lemma proves background enhancement; observational α-collapse confirms emptiness
testable_predictions: All testable by Euclid DR1/DR2 (2026–2028) and DESI DR3 (~2027–2028)

falsification_criteria.condition: Mechanism found where ΔE² > 0 with E(0) = 1
falsification_criteria.implication: Sign lemma violated; requires non-monotonic gate

falsification_criteria.condition: α ≠ 0 detected at > 3σ in CMB + BAO joint fit
falsification_criteria.implication: Background gate not empty; observational pillar fails
